faces.name: Ultima
faces.oracleText: Destroy all artifacts and creatures. End the turn. (Exile all spells and abilities from the stack, including this card. The player whose turn it is discards down to their maximum hand size. Damage wears off, and "this turn" and "until end of turn" effects end.)

faces.name: Ultima, Origin of Oblivion
faces.oracleText:
Flying
Whenever Ultima attacks, put a blight counter on target land. For as long as that land has a blight counter on it, it loses all land types and abilities and has "{T}: Add {C}."
Whenever you tap a land for {C}, add an additional {C}.
